1.title: The Riddle House and the Portkey · Quiz

questions.question: What is Voldemort trying to do at the Riddle House?
questions.explanation: 伏地魔正在策划复活，并要求虫尾巴召集旧日追随者。

questions.question: Who is killed at the beginning of the story?
questions.explanation: 谜语屋的老园丁弗兰克·布莱斯被伏地魔杀害。

questions.question: How do Harry and the Weasleys travel to the Quidditch World Cup?
questions.explanation: 他们使用一只旧靴子门钥匙，被传送到魁地奇世界杯营地。

questions.question: What does Voldemort tell Wormtail to do first?
questions.explanation: 伏地魔让虫尾巴先召集他们过去的同伴，为后续行动做准备。

questions.question: Who travels with Harry and the Weasley family to the World Cup?
questions.explanation: 迪戈里先生和他的儿子塞德里克也与哈利一行人同行。

2.title: The Quidditch World Cup and the Dark Mark · Quiz

questions.question: What major event are the characters attending?
questions.explanation: 这一集的主要活动是魁地奇世界杯决赛。

questions.question: What appears in the sky after the attack on the campsite?
questions.explanation: 食死徒袭击营地后，天空中出现了黑魔标记。

questions.question: What happens to Harry's scar after the attack?
questions.explanation: 袭击发生后，哈利的伤疤再次疼痛，让他感到不安。

questions.question: Which famous Seeker does Ron admire at the World Cup?
questions.explanation: 罗恩非常崇拜保加利亚队的著名找球手维克多·克鲁姆。

questions.question: Why does Arthur tell everyone to leave the campsite?

options.text: The campsite is closing for the night

questions.explanation: 营地遭到食死徒袭击，亚瑟提醒大家赶快撤离并保持在一起。

3.title: Hogwarts Welcomes the Visiting Schools · Quiz

questions.question: Which two schools visit Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: 来到霍格沃茨的两所学校是布斯巴顿和德姆斯特朗。

questions.question: What competition does Dumbledore announce?
questions.explanation: 邓布利多宣布霍格沃茨将举办三强争霸赛。

questions.question: What does Dumbledore explain about each chosen champion?

options.text: The champion may refuse after selection
The champion must face the challenges alone
The champion only watches the other schools
The champion can choose a team

questions.explanation: 邓布利多强调，每所学校只选出一名勇士，勇士必须独自面对挑战。

questions.question: Which school is hosting the Triwizard Tournament this year?
questions.explanation: 今年的三强争霸赛由霍格沃茨承办。

questions.question: What age rule does Barty Crouch announce?

options.text: Only students over twenty can enter

questions.explanation: 克劳奇宣布，未满17岁的学生不得报名参加三强争霸赛。

4.title: The Goblet and Moody's First Lesson · Quiz

questions.question: What object chooses the champions for the tournament?
questions.explanation: 三强争霸赛的勇士由火焰杯选出。

questions.question: Who is the new Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher?
questions.explanation: 新任黑魔法防御术教师是阿拉斯托·穆迪。

questions.question: How does Moody say he prefers to teach the Dark Arts?

options.text: By asking students to watch a film

questions.explanation: 穆迪认为学习黑魔法防御术应采用实际演示的方式。

questions.question: What must a student do to enter the tournament?

options.text: Ask a champion to nominate them
Write their name on parchment and put it in the Goblet

questions.explanation: 报名者要把自己的名字写在羊皮纸上，再投入火焰杯。

questions.question: What warning is given to students who enter the tournament?

options.text: If chosen, they cannot turn back
They must compete in every school subject

questions.explanation: 邓布利多提醒学生，若被选中，就不能退出比赛。

5.title: Unforgivable Curses and the Age Line · Quiz

questions.question: Why are the three curses called Unforgivable?

options.text: They are used only in tournaments
Using them can send a wizard to Azkaban

questions.explanation: 不可饶恕咒会造成严重伤害，使用者可能因此被送进阿兹卡班。

questions.question: What do Fred and George try to do?

options.text: Enter their names in the Goblet despite the age limit

questions.explanation: 弗雷德和乔治想绕过年龄限制，把名字投入火焰杯。

questions.question: What happens when Fred and George cross the Age Line?
questions.explanation: 邓布利多设置的年龄线阻止了他们，两人被魔法弹开。

questions.question: Which curse makes a person obey another wizard's commands?
questions.explanation: 穆迪演示的魂魄出窍咒可以控制受咒者的行动。

questions.question: Who is the only person known to have survived the Killing Curse?
questions.explanation: 穆迪指出，哈利是唯一已知从索命咒下幸存的人。

questions.question: Who is selected first as the Hogwarts champion?
questions.explanation: 火焰杯首先选出的霍格沃茨勇士是塞德里克·迪戈里。

questions.question: Which students are selected from the visiting schools?
questions.explanation: 布斯巴顿选出芙蓉·德拉库尔，德姆斯特朗选出维克多·克鲁姆。

questions.question: What surprises everyone after the three champions are chosen?

options.text: Ron is chosen as a champion
Harry's name comes out of the Goblet too

questions.explanation: 三位勇士选出后，火焰杯又吐出了哈利的名字，令所有人震惊。

questions.question: Why does Harry have no choice but to compete?

options.text: The Goblet creates a binding magical contract
Cedric chooses him as a partner
The Ministry has already given him a prize

questions.explanation: 邓布利多解释，火焰杯的选择构成有约束力的魔法契约，哈利不能退出。

questions.question: What is the prize that the champions hope to win?
questions.explanation: 三强争霸赛的最终奖品是三强争霸赛奖杯。

7.title: Harry Is Forced to Compete · Quiz

questions.question: Why does Harry say he did not enter the tournament?

options.text: He has already won the tournament
He did not put his name in the Goblet

questions.explanation: 哈利坚持说自己没有把名字投入火焰杯。

questions.question: How many Hogwarts champions are now involved in the tournament?
questions.explanation: 霍格沃茨原本选出塞德里克，后来哈利也被选中，因此有两名勇士。

questions.question: What does Harry want most at this point?

options.text: To leave the tournament and go home
To understand why he was chosen

questions.explanation: 哈利并不想出名，他最想弄清楚自己为何会被火焰杯选中。

questions.question: Who argues that Harry should not be allowed to compete?
questions.explanation: 麦格教授认为不应该让哈利继续参加危险的比赛。

questions.question: What does Dumbledore decide to do while they try to understand what happened?

options.text: Let events unfold and watch carefully

questions.explanation: 邓布利多决定暂时让事情继续发展，同时观察并查明背后的原因。

questions.question: Why does Sirius contact Harry secretly?

options.text: To ask him to join the Quidditch team
To teach him a new spell
To invite him to the Yule Ball

questions.explanation: 小天狼星秘密联系哈利，是为了提醒他目前存在危险。

questions.question: What does Sirius say about the Triwizard Tournament?

options.text: It is only a friendly game
No magic is allowed in it

questions.explanation: 小天狼星明确提醒哈利，三强争霸赛可能会有人丧命。

questions.question: Who does Sirius identify as a former Death Eater?
questions.explanation: 小天狼星告诉哈利，德姆斯特朗校长卡卡洛夫曾经是食死徒。

questions.question: Why does Sirius avoid sending Hedwig with his message?

options.text: Hedwig is too young to fly
The Ministry is intercepting more owls, and Hedwig is easy to recognize
Harry has asked him not to use owls
The owl post is closed for the tournament

questions.explanation: 魔法部正在拦截越来越多的猫头鹰，而且海德薇很容易被认出来。

questions.question: Where does Sirius ask Harry to meet him?

options.text: In the Great Hall at noon
In the Gryffindor common room at one o'clock
By the Black Lake at sunset

questions.explanation: 小天狼星约哈利星期六凌晨一点在格兰芬多公共休息室见面，并要求他独自前往。

questions.question: What does Hagrid secretly show Harry?
questions.explanation: 海格带哈利秘密观看三强争霸赛第一项任务中的巨龙。

questions.question: Why is Harry worried after seeing the dragons?

options.text: They are part of the first task
He has to fight Viktor Krum

questions.explanation: 哈利意识到第一项任务要面对巨龙，因此感到担忧。

questions.question: What must Harry prepare to face in the first task?
questions.explanation: 这一集揭示了第一项任务的核心挑战：勇士必须面对巨龙。

questions.question: What does Hagrid ask Harry to bring with him?
questions.explanation: 海格特意让哈利带上父亲留下的隐形衣，以免被人发现。

questions.question: Who meets Hagrid near the dragons?
questions.explanation: 哈格力与布斯巴顿校长马克西姆夫人见面，显得十分在意她。

10.title: First Task: The Hungarian Horntail · Quiz

questions.question: What must each champion collect during the first task?
questions.explanation: 第一项任务要求每位勇士从巨龙那里取得金蛋。

questions.question: Which dragon does Harry face?
questions.explanation: 哈利面对的是危险的匈牙利树蜂。

questions.question: What skill helps Harry escape the dragon?
questions.explanation: 哈利利用飞行能力和飞天扫帚躲避巨龙，争取夺取金蛋的机会。

questions.question: What does each golden egg contain?

options.text: A clue for the next task

questions.explanation: 克劳奇说明，每个金蛋里都有通往下一项任务的线索。

questions.question: Which dragon does Viktor Krum face?
questions.explanation: 任务开始前，勇士们得知克鲁姆面对的是中国火球龙。

11.title: Ron and Harry Reconcile; the Yule Ball Is Announced · Quiz

questions.question: Why do Harry and Ron make up?

options.text: Dumbledore orders them to be friends
They talk about their disagreement and clear things up
They win the House Cup together

questions.explanation: 哈利和罗恩终于谈开了之前的误会，恢复了友谊。

questions.question: What event is announced at Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: 霍格沃茨宣布将举行圣诞舞会。

questions.question: What are students expected to do for the Yule Ball?

options.text: Find partners and prepare to dance
Bring a dragon to the hall

questions.explanation: 学生们需要寻找舞伴，并为正式舞会做准备。

questions.question: What had Ron wrongly believed Harry had done?

options.text: Put his own name in the Goblet of Fire

questions.explanation: 罗恩承认自己曾以为哈利偷偷把名字放进了火焰杯。

questions.question: What does Hermione tell Ron when he asks whether she has a partner?

options.text: She does not want to attend the ball
She has already agreed to go with someone
She is waiting for a message from Dumbledore

questions.explanation: 赫敏告诉罗恩，已经有人邀请她参加舞会，而且她答应了。

12.title: Asking for Dates and the Yule Ball · Quiz

questions.question: What are the students trying to find before the Yule Ball?
questions.explanation: 舞会前，学生们忙着寻找合适的舞伴。

questions.question: Why do some students feel awkward during the preparations?

options.text: They feel nervous about asking someone to the ball
They are not allowed to dance

questions.explanation: 邀请别人做舞伴让一些学生感到紧张和尴尬。

questions.question: What happens during the Yule Ball?

options.text: Students gather for a formal dance

questions.explanation: 圣诞舞会举行，学生们参加正式舞会并共舞。

questions.question: Who does Harry ask to go to the ball with him?
questions.explanation: 哈利鼓起勇气邀请秋·张参加舞会。

questions.question: Why does Cho turn down Harry's invitation?

options.text: She has been chosen for the next task
She does not know what the Yule Ball is
She has already agreed to go with someone else

questions.explanation: 秋·张告诉哈利，她已经答应和别人一起参加舞会。

questions.question: What is Harry trying to understand in this episode?

options.text: The clue inside the golden egg

questions.explanation: 哈利一直在研究金蛋里的声音和线索。

questions.question: Who gives Harry a useful hint about the golden egg?
questions.explanation: 桃金娘给哈利提示，帮助他找到理解金蛋线索的方法。

questions.question: Where does Harry finally understand the egg's message?
questions.explanation: 哈利把金蛋放到水下，终于听清了里面的内容。

questions.question: What does Cedric suggest Harry do with the golden egg?

options.text: Take it into the hot water in the Prefects' bathroom
Leave it in the Great Hall overnight
Ask Professor Moody to open it
Put it beside the Goblet of Fire

questions.explanation: 塞德里克建议哈利带着金蛋到级长盥洗室，在热水中仔细思考线索。

questions.question: Why does Moody send Ron and Hermione away before the second task?

options.text: They must repair the golden egg
They are needed at the Yule Ball
They have to meet the other champions
He says Harry needs a good night's sleep

questions.explanation: 穆迪让罗恩和赫敏离开，表示哈利已经准备好了，应该早点休息。

14.title: Second Task: The Black Lake · Quiz

questions.question: Where does the second task take place?
questions.explanation: 三强争霸赛第二项任务在黑湖中进行。

questions.question: What must the champions do underwater?

options.text: Reach the centre of a maze
Rescue the people held at the bottom of the lake

questions.explanation: 勇士们必须潜入黑湖，找到并救回被留在水下的人。

questions.question: Why does Harry stay underwater longer than expected?

options.text: He tries to help more than one person
He forgets the task's time limit
He cannot find the way back

questions.explanation: 哈利救出罗恩后，还努力帮助其他遇险者，因此耽搁了时间。

questions.question: Who tells Harry that gillyweed may help him breathe underwater?
questions.explanation: 纳威告诉哈利，可以使用鳃囊草在水下呼吸。

questions.question: Whom does Harry rescue after finding Ron?
questions.explanation: 哈利找到罗恩后，又返回去救芙蓉的妹妹加布丽。

15.title: Moral Fiber and Crouch's Disappearance · Quiz

questions.question: What does Harry's action during the second task show?

options.text: He is determined to help others
He wants to leave the tournament

questions.explanation: 哈利不只顾着完成任务，还坚持救助其他人，体现了他的善良和勇气。

questions.question: Which important person becomes difficult to find?
questions.explanation: 第二项任务后，巴蒂·克劳奇的异常和失踪引起了关注。

questions.question: What place is Harry awarded after the judges consider his rescue?
questions.explanation: 评委认为哈利救人的表现值得肯定，因此给了他第二名。

questions.question: Whose sister does Harry save in the Black Lake?
questions.explanation: 哈利救下的是芙蓉·德拉库尔的妹妹加布丽。

questions.question: Why does Fleur thank Harry after the task?

options.text: He won the task for her
He gave her the golden egg

questions.explanation: 芙蓉感谢哈利，因为哈利冒险帮助救回了她的妹妹。

questions.question: What is the Pensieve used for?
questions.explanation: 冥想盆可以让人重新观看自己经历过的记忆。

questions.question: What does Karkaroff provide during his testimony?

options.text: Names and evidence about Death Eaters
A clue to the golden egg

questions.explanation: 卡卡洛夫为了争取释放，向审判委员会提供食死徒的名字和线索。

questions.question: Which plant is discussed as useful for breathing underwater?
questions.explanation: 哈利使用的鳃囊草可以帮助他在水下呼吸。

questions.question: What does Karkaroff hope to receive in return for his testimony?
questions.explanation: 卡卡洛夫希望自己的证词有价值，从而获得提前离开阿兹卡班的机会。

questions.question: What potion does Snape suspect Harry and his friends are making?
questions.explanation: 斯内普发现相关材料被取用后，怀疑哈利和朋友们在制作复方汤剂。

questions.question: Where does the third task take place?
questions.explanation: 第三项任务是在危险的魔法迷宫中进行。

questions.question: What are the champions trying to reach?
questions.explanation: 勇士们要穿过迷宫，最先触碰三强争霸赛奖杯的人获胜。

questions.question: What makes the third task dangerous?

options.text: The maze is filled with ordinary animals

questions.explanation: 迷宫中有各种魔法障碍，勇士还可能在里面迷失方向。

questions.question: How can a champion ask to leave the maze?

options.text: Touch the maze wall three times
Send up red sparks with a wand

questions.explanation: 邓布利多说明，想退出任务的勇士可以用魔杖发出红色火花。

questions.question: Who knows the exact position of the Triwizard Cup in the maze?
questions.explanation: 主持人说明，奖杯由穆迪放在迷宫深处，只有他知道准确位置。

questions.question: Where are Harry and Cedric transported when they touch the cup?
questions.explanation: 哈利和塞德里克同时触碰奖杯后，被门钥匙传送到墓地。

questions.question: What happens to Cedric in the graveyard?
questions.explanation: 伏地魔命令虫尾巴杀死塞德里克，塞德里克不幸遇害。

questions.question: What does Voldemort achieve through the dark ritual?

options.text: He returns to a physical body

questions.explanation: 仪式完成后，伏地魔恢复了身体，重新获得实体。

questions.question: Whose bone is used in Voldemort's return ritual?
questions.explanation: 复活仪式需要父亲的骨，字幕中伏地魔明确说出这一材料。

questions.question: What does Cedric ask Harry to do after he is killed?

options.text: Tell the Ministry to cancel the tournament
Hide his wand in the maze
Take his body back to his father
Take the Triwizard Cup to Dumbledore

questions.explanation: 塞德里克临终前请求哈利把自己的遗体带回去交给父亲。

questions.question: Who is revealed as the person behind the events?

options.text: Barty Crouch Jr., disguised as Mad-Eye Moody

questions.explanation: 假穆迪的真实身份是小巴蒂·克劳奇，他一直伪装成穆迪。

questions.question: What potion is connected with the disguise?
questions.explanation: 小巴蒂·克劳奇使用复方汤剂伪装成穆迪。

questions.question: Why does Dumbledore question the suspect?

options.text: To decide who wins the House Cup
To uncover how the tournament was manipulated

questions.explanation: 邓布利多要弄清哈利为何被送进墓地，以及比赛是如何被操纵的。

questions.question: What does the false Moody admit he did to the Goblet of Fire?

options.text: He gave the Goblet to Karkaroff
He put Harry's name into it

questions.explanation: 假穆迪承认是自己把哈利的名字放进了火焰杯。

questions.question: What does Barty Crouch Jr. say has happened to Voldemort?

options.text: He has lost his powers forever
He has left the wizarding world

questions.explanation: 小巴蒂·克劳奇确认伏地魔已经归来。

questions.question: What does Hogwarts hold to remember Cedric?
questions.explanation: 霍格沃茨举行纪念仪式，悼念在比赛中遇害的塞德里克。

questions.question: What does Dumbledore warn the students about?

options.text: The Quidditch World Cup is cancelled

questions.explanation: 邓布利多提醒大家，黑暗而艰难的时期即将到来。

questions.question: What do Harry and his friends promise to do?
questions.explanation: 离别时，哈利和朋友们约定暑假期间继续联系。

questions.question: Why does Dumbledore tell the students the truth about Cedric's death?

options.text: Because the tournament rules require it
Because they have the right to know, and silence would insult Cedric's memory
Because the Ministry has ordered him to
Because Cedric's family asks him to cancel the memorial

questions.explanation: 邓布利多认为学生有权知道真相，不说出实情反而是对塞德里克的侮辱。

questions.question: What does Dumbledore remind Harry and the students they have?

options.text: Friends who will stand with them
A way to avoid every danger
A promise that nothing will change
A new tournament to prepare for

questions.explanation: 邓布利多告诉哈利，他们有朋友相伴，并不是孤单一人。
